name: Hereditary Hypomagnesemia with Secondary Hypocalcemia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Hereditary Hypomagnesemia with Secondary Hypocalcemia

criteria.description: Persistent hypomagnesemia due to renal magnesium wasting
Positive family history consistent with autosomal recessive inheritance
Identification of pathogenic mutations in genes associated with renal magnesium transport (e.g., TRPM6)
Normal or low-normal vitamin D levels excluding vitamin D deficiency as cause of hypocalcemia

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of persistent hypomagnesemia with renal magnesium wasting and secondary hypocalcemia, plus either genetic confirmation or consistent family history
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other causes of hypomagnesemia and hypocalcemia.

pathognomonic.notes: Often presenting in infancy or early childhood
Includes carpopedal spasms and muscle cramps

common.notes: Generalized weakness due to electrolyte imbalance
Non-specific symptom related to electrolyte disturbances
Due to electrolyte abnormalities affecting cardiac conduction

occasional.notes: Behavioral changes in infants and children

rare.notes: Sensorineural hearing impairment reported in some cases

laboratory: Hypomagnesemia with increased renal magnesium excretion
Hypocalcemia with low parathyroid hormone (secondary hypoparathyroidism)
Normal or low-normal vitamin D levels
Elevated alkaline phosphatase in some cases
imaging: Occasional brain MRI may show nonspecific changes related to seizures
genetic: Other rare mutations affecting renal magnesium transport
other: Positive family history consistent with autosomal recessive inheritance
Response to magnesium supplementation with correction of hypocalcemia

distinguishingFeatures: Later onset in adolescence or adulthood
Primary hypoparathyroidism causing hypocalcemia without hypomagnesemia
History of gastrointestinal disease or malabsorption
Improvement with oral magnesium supplementation alone

redFlags: Seizures unresponsive to anticonvulsants without magnesium correction
Early onset tetany or seizures in infancy
references: Nijenhuis T, et al. Hereditary hypomagnesemia with secondary hypocalcemia: clinical and molecular aspects. Nephrol Dial Transplant. 2005;20(10):2090-2096.
Schlingmann KP, et al. Hypomagnesemia with secondary hypocalcemia is caused by mutations in TRPM6, a new member of the TRPM gene family. Nat Genet. 2002;31(2):166-170.
